text:
ada: Quick announcement: we're introducing a "soft-cap" protection and clearer invoice line items to reduce surprise overages. The soft-cap will gently slow request throughput when projected monthly spend exceeds a configurable threshold, plus provide explicit invoice tags. Docs: https://redwood.internal/billing/soft-cap

li: Clarify: does soft-cap stop requests or just pace them?

ada: It paces. Requests may be delayed briefly; we avoid outright drops unless the soft-cap is exceeded repeatedly. We'll emit X-Redwood-SoftCap: active and SoftCap-Remaining headers so clients can adapt.

omar: Billing impact: will customers still be charged for tokens delayed by pacing?

billing-bot: Billing unchanged: only completed tokens are charged. If pacing leads to a system timeout that causes failed completions, billing team will review and can grant credits case-by-case. New invoice tags will show "SoftCap Pacing" when applicable.

support: Adding KB with troubleshooting steps and sample curl for detecting headers. ETA: tonight.

ada: Rollout: staged next Tue 08:00 PT (10% -> 50% -> 100% over 24h). Pre-notify top usage accounts 48h prior. Please raise any concerns in #billing before EOD Friday. TL;DR: soft-cap pacing to reduce surprise bills, header signals, invoices will show pacing as a line item for transparency.
